Prevention of Terrorism Act, 2000; Ss. 3(3), 4; 20, 21(2){b), 22(3), 34(1)(4)/Penal Code, 1860; Ss. l 20(B), 286, 307 and 337/Explosive A B Substances Act, 1908; Ss. 3, 4 & 6: C Charges under Prevention of Terrorism Act-Initiation of proceedings against accused-Challenging the order of Special accused-Acquitting him in one of the cases under POTA, High Court rejected his prayer for bail in the other case under POTA and dismissed the appeal-On appeal, Held: High Court was not justified in concluding D the matter in the later case in POTA in view of the observations made in the former
